list.emptyMessage: No teacher has been given this section yet.
list.classListErrorMessage: Failed to load the class list.
list.subtitle: Who is class teacher and who teaches what, section by section
list.noClassesExplanation: Add a class and its sections and teachers show up here.

help.class: Which class's sections you will look at. You also choose it when giving from the teacher's page.
help.section: Which section, when giving from the teacher's page. You can choose it after choosing the class.
help.teacher: The person you will give the duty to. The employee ID is beside the name. Only staff who have a teacher profile.
help.assignmentType: **Class teacher** (only one per section; a new one replaces the earlier), **Assistant class teacher**, or **Subject teacher** (for one subject).
help.subject: Only for a **Subject teacher**: which subject. From the active subjects.
help.coordinatorKind: **Class coordinator** sees every subject of the class. **Subject coordinator** sees only one subject. Both only read; they never change marks or attendance.
help.coordinatorClasses: One or more classes of this year. A coordinator sees every section of each class.
help.coordinatorSubject: Leave empty for a **Class coordinator**. Choose a subject for a **Subject coordinator**.

helpRequired.class: Yes (when giving from the teacher's page)
helpRequired.section: Yes (when giving from the teacher's page)
helpRequired.assignmentType: Yes, **Class teacher** is chosen to begin with
helpRequired.subject: Yes, for **Subject teacher**
